spec2def(framedyn.dll framedyn.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# framedyn.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/framedyn-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(framedyn_shims OBJECT main.c chstring.cpp provider.cpp)
target_link_libraries(framedyn_shims PRIVATE cpprt liboleaut32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(framedyn_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_target_cpp_properties(framedyn_shims WITH_EXCEPTIONS)
add_cargo_module(framedyn framedyn-cargo framedyn.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/wbem
    EXTRA_DEPENDS framedyn_shims xdk)
